name: spf64-forth
description: Language support for SP-Forth (spf64): diagnostics, completion, hover, go-to-definition, outline -- powered by an LSP server written in spf64 itself.

spf64.serverPath.description: Path to the spf64 executable that runs the LSP server.

spf64.serverScript.description: Path to lsp-server.f (the server is started as: spf64 <serverScript>).

spf64.spfx64Root.description: spf-x64 (dsForth64) checkout: used to resolve .wdb source locations of baked words.

spf64.wdb.description: Extra .wdb files (word TAB addr TAB voc TAB file TAB line). Empty = <spf64>.wdb + the spfx64Root defaults.

spf64.scanRoots.description: Directories to index for definitions. Empty = the workspace root + <exedir>\devel.
